background: Bendigo and Adelaide Bank is Australia's largest regional bank, funded mainly by retail deposits raised through a community-branch model and lending mainly on residential mortgages and to farms and small businesses.
synthesis: Ratings are A- from Fitch and S&P and A3 from Moody's, all stable, with Moody's upgrade to A3 on 21 Nov 2025 the latest move. Capital is the weak point against Australian peers: CET1 of 11.3% is in the bottom quarter against a 12.0% median. Liquidity is the strength, with LCR of 140% in the top quarter and NSFR of 115% at the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. The flagged news is mixed: a return to profit on 24 Aug 2026, set against a cash-earnings hit from risk remediation and an anti-money-laundering capital charge reported on 24 Aug 2026 and 25 Aug 2026.
